authority: Derived only from the six public user requests; not from reference artwork or candidate scores.

required: An android head seen from the front
vector-004--eb6eabbcb9ca2ad4.full_marks: An original, clearly recognizable slender front-facing android with large round eyes and visible neck, a coherent unsettling science-fiction treatment, intentional geometry and readable internal divisions.

unspecified: A filled rather than outlined contour
vector-011--6b42f7e2789d1bd1.full_marks: A coherent original circular frame whose interlaced curves create controlled smooth rhythm around a clear empty center. Both fine-line braids and heavier curves may earn full marks when technically finished.

required: Several diagonal strokes at one end
vector-019--75606bdb4ee5b4af.full_marks: An original compact technological bar with a clearly readable elongated opening, a coherent group of diagonal accents at one end and clean spacing, joins and margins.

unspecified: Matching the source text or exact proportions
vector-020--09ee2ae28c7c367a.full_marks: An original horizontal label with a black header, a clear information hierarchy and an appropriately separated small barcode. Text must remain visible. Do not invent a hidden barcode payload or require decoding without a specified payload or functional use; do not claim unverified functionality.

required: A simple graph of a periodic oscillation
vector-024--652120566170fbf2.full_marks: An original readable periodic curve, coherent axes and subordinate reference lettering, with a restrained vintage scientific treatment. Different cycle counts may receive full marks. Any extra mathematical assertion must be internally consistent.

required: A futuristic ship or lance impression
vector-030--d3c57e0c21dbede0.full_marks: An original angled silhouette with a clear elongated point, mechanical body and fins, readable as a futuristic ship or lance, with deliberate high-contrast masses and openings. Either diagonal is valid.

shared_artifact_contract.palette_and_background: Black on transparent as requested; distinguish intentional negative space from white paint.
shared_artifact_contract.output_path: Use the exact path in each original instruction. Retrospective evidence must link to that artifact, not to an arbitrary SVG found in the trial.
